conclusions: Terraform was confirmed as the infrastructure-as-code tool for the Docker-based VPS stack.
The proposed Terraform module layout is one module each for docker, postgres, neo4j, elasticsearch, redis, and services (embeddings on 8503 and reranker on 8504), plus a new monitoring module.

Prometheus plus Grafana, with Alertmanager, was confirmed as the monitoring stack, scraping node, postgres, redis and neo4j exporters plus custom /metrics endpoints on the embeddings and reranker services.
